title: Paprika Ad Astra (for Michael Bean)
author: Moose Flores
problems: The progression after row 7 "ones balance & swing, end with giving right hand to next neighbors · swing" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
